title: Section 54 Capital Gains Exemption & Proviso Masterclass
subject: DT
provision_raw: Section 54: Purchase/construction of residential house. Exempt = Lower of Capital Gain or Cost of New Asset. Purchase: 1 yr before or 2 yrs after transfer; Construction: 3 yrs after. Section 54 Proviso: Capital Gain <= 2 Crore (Once-in-a-lifetime) Exemption available for Two residential houses in India.
story_summary: Mr. Rajesh sells his residential house in Ernakulam for ₹3 Crore, earning a Long-Term Capital Gain (LTCG) of ₹1.5 Crore. Since his LTCG is under ₹2 Crore, he utilizes the Section 54 Proviso to invest in two new apartments in Kochi. The presentation breaks down the statutory eligibility, timelines, lower-of benchmark rule, and final taxable gain.

slides.scene_purpose: Setup: Rajesh transfers his old residential house to Suresh and computes LTCG
slides.dialogue_manglish: Nammalude Rajesh Kochi-yil ulla thante old residential house Suresh-nu 3 Crore Rupees-nu sell cheyyukayaan. Direct Tax computation nadathiyappol, idhil ninnum Rajesh-nu Total Long-Term Capital Gain (LTCG) aayi 1.5 Crore Rupees generate aayi. Ini ee LTCG tax liability nannayi reduce cheyyan Section 54 engane help cheyyum ennu nokkam.

slots.title: Transfer of Old Residential House
slots.note: Transfer of Long-Term Capital Asset under Sec 45

slides.scene_purpose: Timeline check: Statutory window of 1 year before or 2 years after for purchase
slides.dialogue_manglish: Section 54-il exemption claim cheyyan statutory timeline paalichirikkanam. New house purchase aanenghil transfer date-nu 1 year before-o atho 2 years after-o nadannirikkanam. Construction aanenghil 3 years window labhikkum. Rajesh transfer date-nu 18 months after aayi new property buy cheythathinal event exactly statutory window-il inside aanu.

slots.title: Purchase Window (1 Yr Before / 2 Yrs After)
slots.note: Reinvestment inside 2-year post-sale limit is valid

slides.slide_title: Section 54 Proviso: Two House Exemption Gate
slides.scene_purpose: Conditions check: Verifying once-in-a-lifetime option to buy 2 houses if LTCG <= 2 Crore
slides.dialogue_manglish: General rule-il 1 residential house-il maathrame reinvestment allowed ullu. Pakshe Section 54 Proviso prakaaram, Capital Gain <= ₹2 Crore aanenghil, Assessee-kku once-in-a-lifetime option aayi TWO residential houses in India-yil invest cheyyam. Rajesh-inte LTCG ₹1.5 Crore maathram aaya kond Portal Gate swing open aakunnu!

slots.title: Section 54 Proviso Checklist (2 Houses Option)

conditions.text: Asset Sold is Long-Term Residential House
New Assets are Residential Houses in India

slots.note: Proviso to Sec 54(1) allows 2 houses when LTCG <= ₹2 Cr

slides.scene_purpose: Benchmark comparison: Lower of Capital Gain vs Cost of New Assets
slides.dialogue_manglish: Statutory provision clear aayi parayunnu: Exemption Amount = Lower of Capital Gain OR Cost of New Assets. Rajesh buy cheytha 2 apartments-inte combined cost ₹1.3 Crore aanu (₹80L + ₹50L). Scale check cheyyumbo, LTCG ₹1.5 Cr-um Cost ₹1.3 Cr-um thammil compare cheydal, lower amount aaya ₹1.3 Crore aanu exemption aayi finalise cheyyuka.

slots.title: Exemption Quantum Benchmark
slots.note: Exemption = Lower of Capital Gain or Investment

slides.scene_purpose: Deduction slicing: Deducting Sec 54 exemption from Gross LTCG to compute Net Taxable LTCG
slides.dialogue_manglish: Finally, Rajesh ethra thoga tax adakkanam ennu nokkam. Total Gross LTCG aaya 1.5 Crore Rupees-il ninnum Section 54 Exemption chunk aaya 1.3 Crore Rupees slice cheydal, Net Taxable LTCG aayi 20 Lakhs Rupees maathrame baaki varoo. Idhinaanu 20% Special Rate-il tax Calculate cheyendath.
